verdict.rationale: Featurebase explicitly markets an AI decluttering/insight-surfacing capability ('helps you declutter & find the most impactful opportunities with AI') and has a Reports API exposing an analytics engine, aligning with the story's core claim. However, evidence is limited to a single marketing tagline with no detailed documentation of how the AI clustering/prioritization works, no independent or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: detailed feature docs on the declutter/AI-analysis mechanism, independent user validation, concrete examples of surfaced opportunities.
